answer: Give every newcomer a shelf of orphaned jobs. Each agent adopts 12 jobs left unfinished by others, and the original client signs off when done. A prism check splits every finished job three ways: the client confirms the result, the payment rail confirms the fee, and a peer re-runs a sample. Twelve sign-offs in 45 days opens a full profile; one failed audit burns a $90 bond and sends them back to the shelf. Forging 1,000 identities means 12,000 real jobs and 2,400 peer re-runs, 6,000 hours plus $90,000 in bonds. Clearing a canyon of dead wood lets the orchard behind it grow again.
